changes.comment: Your files stay the source of truth. Edits made outside the app — in Obsidian, in git, by an agent — are reconciled in, and a file the app did not change is never rewritten, so no spurious diffs appear in git.
Vault state survives a crash: documents, the journal and merge bases are stored durably, and an operation interrupted part-way is recovered on the next start rather than abandoned.
Folders can be carved out into their own shared mount and folded back again, with crash recovery at every step of the move.
Fixed a race where a document reconciling against itself could bring back stale content. Merge bases are now taken as one consistent snapshot and reconciles are serialised per document.
